notes.title: iDGi 21 Winter Sol2t1ce 21 update
notes.notes:
iDGi development update

Greet1ng2 Seekers,

[previewyoutube=wN_H3YB9UCA;full][/previewyoutube]

Wit2 th1s year’s massive solstice iDGi-1 signal boost, the CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered project is now juuuust about complete. Brand new Consortium King convo, finished briefing, tutorials. Major fixes, completely finished choreography, new music.

We just released V0.1.24!  Now available to all players of CVR Beta Early Access and CONSORTIUM Remastered Playtest. Here is the complete changelist: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1428880/view/3864716013041789752 

The release of this Beta playtest update (CVR Beta Early Access and CONSORTIUM Remastered Playtest) is basically the signal of the start of the FINAL Beta Test phase. Further patches will largely be only for last minute tweaks, fixe2, music 1mprovements and finishing the very very ending. We can now confidently say that –

CONSORTIUM Remastered v1.0 will be launching at the same time that CONSORTIUM VR emerges from Early Access, in Q1 2024.

For 14 years or so since it originally came on-line, iDGi-1 has been revealing more and more of a world that is, in some ways, a bright mirror to our own; an aspirational world, but some terrifying events have been chronicled in the CONSORTIUM and TOWER streams. How does it all end? It may still take awhile longer, but we simply will not stop until the TOWER stream is completed.

We once again thank everyone that reads this who continues to be patient with our long and drawn out project timelines. We sincerely wish each and every one of you a relaxing and peaceful holiday season. 

Can we ALL somehow find a way to make it collectively through 2024 in one piece?!    

Namaste,

–iDGi

–iDGi on Discord

“Sometimes you can find peace of mind by transferring yourself to different situations. They're just reminders to stay ... calm.” 
—Yves Behar

"It's one world, pal. We're all neighbors" 
—Frank Sinatra

notes.title: April 21st TOWER dev update
notes.notes:
Happy 21 day everyone,

Earth Day is almost here. A day where we celebrate our shared home, planet Earth, and its incredible beauty and diversity. Let's take a moment to appreciate the natural wonders that surround us and commit to nurturing our environment for future generations. Here's to a brighter, healthier, and more eco-friendly world!  

Consortium: THE TOWER

Consortium: THE TOWER remains an active project at iDGi. The Early Access 4.15 build, available on Steam since late 2019, signifies the completion of Phase One of production. While the development process has been lengthy and complex, our original vision for THE TOWER has not changed. Please checkout the following post for more information on our motivations and plans as a company moving forward:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/626250/discussions/0/3829791007686976119/


We are nearing completion of CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered, bringing us closer to commencing Phase Two of Consortium: THE TOWER's production. We have begun integrating the latest CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered features and content into THE TOWER, with plans to release "Alpha 2.0" later this year.

As a result of this effort, Consortium: THE TOWER will now fully support V.R. and V.O.I.C.E. This means that THE TOWER will eventually be coming to Quest and other VR platforms, and the Steam build will soon natively support V.R. (no extra cost to Steam owners).  

The transition between engines UE 4.15 and 4.27 involves significant changes, requiring a substantial amount of time to ensure everything functions correctly. We anticipate that THE TOWER will be released as a UE5 title, but to achieve this, we must first ensure compatibility with UE4 4.27.
Lastly on THE TOWER front, we’d like to share a first glimpse of a choreographed scene in Consortium: THE TOWER, showcasing a little bit of our progress thus far.

[previewyoutube=2dHJwh8B6Bg;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, we have a small surprise for you all... Now that V.O.I.C.E. is "out of the bag", we have decided to make the backer build of THE TOWER available for everyone. That means that anyone can play with the prototype version of V.O.I.C.E. in Consortium: THE TOWER right now. Simply ensure that your Default Mic is on, and you can literally speak dialog lines rather than punch keys.

Namaste,

--iDGi

“Our imagination is the only limit to what we can hope to have in the future.”
― Charles Kettering

notes.title: November 2022 iDGi dev update
notes.notes:
Happy 21 day everyone,

General iDGi Dev Update

The Announce Trailer for our VR INTERACTIVE CINEMA production is getting close to done. The front-end is feeling pretty good now. Credits are almost done. We’ve been continually testing, fixing and polishing the whole thing, but with a particular emphasis on on the ending and beginning.

Today marks 2 years since we’ve started updating you all each and every month on the 21st.  It’s also been just over a decade since we first revealed the initial glimpse of CONSORTIUM.  Here is a very brief look of our game development efforts over all this time. 

Wait for a never before seen glimpse of Consortium: THE TOWER’s Act 2 at the end.

[previewyoutube=9wcggQYqzrI;full][/previewyoutube]

With a bit of luck, we’ll be releasing the Announce Trailer before the December holidays and you’ll all finally realize what we’ve accomplished for VR and how it relates to THE TOWER…

To all of you in the USA, we wish you a wonderful thanksgiving!  

Namaste,

--iDGi

“Imagination allows you to think of the journey worth making.  Motivation gets you started.  But, it’s patience and perseverance that get you there.”
– Ernie J Zelinksi

notes.title: October 2022 iDGi dev update
notes.notes:
Happy 21ish day everyone,

General iDGi Dev Update

Our VR INTERACTIVE CINEMA production has now technically, FINALLY reached early BETA!  However – contrary to what we told you last month, we still aren’t ready to let new playtesters in just yet. We’re a very small team and can only move so fast and work on so much at one time. 

We’ve been working on things like the game ending, credits, the front-end and the announce teaser trailer video. Once this video is ready, we’ll properly announce the project and make our store pages live! THEN we’ll let in the first wave of beta testers…

Here’s a new little glimpse of something else we’ve been working on via iDGi-1:


[previewyoutube=Hd8-KiiB_Bk;full][/previewyoutube]


VR INTERACTIVE CINEMA Streamer List of 21

Calling all VR game streamers!  

We are now actively looking for no more than 21 folks who are into streaming VR games, with the only requirement being that said streamer must have an audience of at least 100 subscribers.  A mixed reality setup using Liv would be ideal!

Everyone chosen will be gifted a DEMO copy of our VR INTERACTIVE CINEMA game. Streamers will get the first chance to put on a performance for their audience unlike any they’ve ever done (we promise!). You will also be the first to experience what we hope will be seen as a brand new genre of VR game. 

Twitch streamers will get the chance to play with our game’s unique Twitch integration that we’ve taken to calling “Breaking The Fifth Wall”.

Hop into our Discord and let us know if you are a VR game steamer (Meta Quest 2 and/or PCVR), or know someone that may be interested. Or, perhaps reach out to your favourite streamer and plead with them to get on our list.  ;-)

To be considered for the “VR INTERACTIVE CINEMA Streamer List of 21”, simply shoot an email to support@interdimensionalgames.com with the subject line “VR INTERACTIVE CINEMA Streamer List of 21”.  Please include in your email a link to your channel where you do VR streaming (Twitch page, YouTube channel, etc).

So what exactly IS VR Interactive Cinema, you ask? Use your imagination and you just might not be too far off… 

Once again until next month, it’s back to the dev caves with us!

Namaste,

--iDGi

“War, except in self-defense, is a failure of moral imagination”
– Bill Moyers

notes.title: 21 Day - A brief glimpse and update.
notes.notes:
Happy [strike]21[/strike] 22 day everyone,

General iDGi Dev Update

After a few weeks of internal testing, debugging and fixing, we finally sent keys out to the first wave of testers for the pre-beta testing for our VR game.  If you are a Tower backer that signed up for testing and haven’t received your key, that means you’ve been assigned to the second wave, roughly around early April.

Whispers From The Rift is still in the middle of being upgraded with many new brainscan images.  How many in total will it have once done?  No-one can say at this time.  Peek into the Whispers From The Rift channel in our iDGi Discord  to see a sneak peek at another new image.

We’ve been steadily receiving updated iDGi-1 Virtual Trainer data of all sorts. Here is a brief snippet of something we’ve recently been transcribing...

https://youtu.be/aJGnL16ShBE

Until next month, it’s back to the dev caves for us…

Namaste,

--iDGi

-- Martin Luther King Jr.

notes.title: Mini update...
notes.notes:
Seasons greetings interdimensional travellers!

This is the first annoucement we've made without a new version having just been uploaded.  

The reason is simple - we're still working on the roadmap and getting things done for EA Alpha v1.4, including new Steam achievements!    We very much want to try and make sure that v1.4 kills as many of the bugs and issues that currently exist in the game as possible, so we're not rushing this one.  There's also been a slight delay on getting the achievements working.  

Speaking of not rushing things... we know many of you are impatient for us to finish this game.  However, it's going to take us as long as it takes.  We're taking our time developing the remainder of the game.  When we do drop the roadmap for you all, it won't include a schedule.  We're not making this game on a schedule, we're realizing our vision of what we want the final game to become, and that's going to take as long as it takes.

Also, after EA Alpha v1.4 releases there will likely be a period where releases will appear to have fewer changes than you've become used to seeing.  They will mostly be fixes and improvements to Act 1 based on continuing feedback from you all, but will eventually include new voice over for things like the hotel mercs, once their lines are finalized.

This is because our tiny team is going to be settling into largely only working on the remainder of the game's levels and content.   This will eventually lead to series of a big "Act 2" update drops to all our "Earliest" access Fig backers, and then here. The rough timeframe for that to start happening is mid-late spring of next year.

In the meantime, there are more Steam achievements for Act 1 of The Tower than there are in the entire first Consortium game, and easily double if not quadruple the amount of total raw gameplay time. 

A reminder - if you want to engage with us and Consortium fans, the best ways are via our iDGi Discord channel and forums

One final note:  I've started twitch streaming again, and will probably continue to do more.  The next time I start a stream I will be sure to post an announcement here on Steam!

Until next time!

Sincerely,

Gregory and iDGi team
